d: Short, charcoal-grey hair is styled in a sleek bob with a side-parted fringe and a single white clip on the left side. The gold-colored eyes are large and round with a neutral expression, set on a youthful face of a teenager. The build is slender, dressed in a white short-sleeved shirt under a grey sleeveless jumper, paired with a blue necktie and a dark grey pleated mini-skirt with white horizontal stripes. Signature details include white gloves, dark grey thigh-high stockings with white stripes, and heavy grey mechanical naval artillery gear attached to the back and held in the arms.
